TC-10/S27.title: The summary call under provider faults (in-process, bedrock.invoke stubbed)
TC-10/S27.detail: Re-run on 43c38a4f because convex/lib/phi.ts (the aiAction wrapper) changed. Spec newspec-c/pre-tc10-s27-provider-faults.spec.ts runs the real convex/ai/parsing.ts parsePreRoundNotes handler with a fake ctx: no browser, no backend, no model (every 'model' answer is a string in the spec). Judged: (a) Haiku throttles twice, then Mistral answers — the full result comes back and the call-log row says model Mistral, fellBackFrom Haiku, ok, providerMs ≤ durationMs (T4, 3.9); (d) a provider that times out like the SDK's abort makes the action reject (no hang). Recorded (open questions): (b) the background prompt failing on all 6 attempts (Haiku, Haiku, Mistral × callJson's 2) → the action still succeeds with background '' and diagnostics ok:true, nothing tells the client; (c) the diagnostics prompt failing → radiology [] silently (both Q14; what the physician then sees is TC-10/S26 R2, failed); (d) 62.5 s to the error vs the ~30 s budget (Q10 / D8); (d') a provider call that never settles is still pending after 120 s (only bedrock.invoke's AbortSignal bounds it). Same outcome as the 10-14 run on e02167f.
